## Overview

Electric, precise, built at night. This is the "quantum" design system, and this file is the single source of truth for visual decisions in the project. The front matter holds the tokens and is the normative part; the sections below say how to apply them.

Written by kernic to the DESIGN.md `alpha` spec. Regenerate it, and the token files beside it, with `kernic context quantum`.

## Colors

Roles, with the light value first:

- **Background** `--background` `#f0f9fc` (dark `#0d1518`): page background.
- **Surface** `--surface` `#e3edf1` (dark `#1f282b`): cards, panels, inputs.
- **Text** `--text` `#0d1518` (dark `#f0f9fc`): body copy and headings.
- **Muted text** `--muted-text` `#5c6c72` (dark `#95a5aa`): secondary text, captions, placeholders.
- **Border** `--border` `#cedade` (dark `#313d41`): hairlines and dividers.
- **Ring** `--ring` `#377ef1`: focus rings.
- **Primary** `--color-primary-600` (hover `--color-primary-500`): buttons, links, the one action on a screen.
- **Accent** `--color-accent-500`: highlights, badges, secondary emphasis. Never a large surface.

Dark mode swaps every role for its dark value. Nothing gets darkened by hand.

## Typography

- Headings: "Inter"
- Body: "Inter"
- Code: "IBM Plex Mono"

No other families. Sizes come from a 1.25 scale on 1rem; the roles in the front matter (display, heading, subheading, body, small, label, code) sit on these steps, each with its line height.

| Token | Size | Line height |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-xs` | `0.800rem` | `1.5` |
| `--text-sm` | `0.894rem` | `1.5` |
| `--text-base` | `1.000rem` | `1.5` |
| `--text-lg` | `1.250rem` | `1.4` |
| `--text-xl` | `1.563rem` | `1.3` |
| `--text-2xl` | `1.953rem` | `1.25` |
| `--text-3xl` | `3.052rem` | `1.2` |
| `--text-4xl` | `4.768rem` | `1.1` |
| `--text-5xl` | `7.451rem` | `1.05` |

Weights: regular 400, medium 500, semibold 600, bold 700 (`--font-weight-*`). Tracking: tight `-0.02em` for display and headings, normal `0em` for body, wide `0.04em` for labels and small caps (`--tracking-*`).

Load the fonts with:

```css
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap");
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap");
```

## Layout

### Spacing

The unit is `0.25rem` (`--spacing`). Named steps are `--space-*`, in rem: 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16. Padding, gaps and margins come from this scale and nothing off it.

### Breakpoints and containers

Breakpoints (`--breakpoint-*`): sm 40rem, md 48rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem, 2xl 96rem. Containers (`--container-*`): sm 40rem, md 48rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem. Prose measures `65ch` (`--measure`).

### Motion

Transitions are brisk: fast `100ms`, base `180ms`, slow `280ms` (`--duration-*`). Easing: out `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` for things arriving, in-out `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` for things moving, emphasized `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0, 1)` for the one moment that deserves it (`--ease-*`). No overshoot on state changes. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` by dropping the transition, not the state.

## Elevation & Depth

Layers are separated first by color: `--surface` sits on `--background`, and `--border` draws the hairline between them. Shadows add depth on top and are tinted from the neutral ramp, so they belong to the palette. Each has a light and a dark value; dark mode uses the denser set.

- `--shadow-xs`: inputs and small controls at rest. Light `0px 1px 2px 0px #0d151814`.
- `--shadow-sm`: cards at rest. Light `0px 1px 3px 0px #0d15181a, 0px 1px 2px -1px #0d15181a`.
- `--shadow-md`: cards on hover, dropdowns. Light `0px 4px 6px -1px #0d15181a, 0px 2px 4px -2px #0d15181a`.
- `--shadow-lg`: popovers, floating panels. Light `0px 10px 15px -3px #0d15181a, 0px 4px 6px -4px #0d15181a`.
- `--shadow-xl`: dialogs and sheets. Light `0px 20px 25px -5px #0d15181a, 0px 8px 10px -6px #0d15181a`.

## Shapes

Corners are soft: `--radius-sm` 0.25rem, `--radius-md` 0.375rem (the default), `--radius-lg` 0.5rem, `--radius-xl` 0.75rem. `rounded.full` (9999px) is for pills and avatars only.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Use only the tokens in this file, by their CSS variable names.
- Put page backgrounds on `--background`, cards and panels on `--surface`, body text in `--text`, secondary text in `--muted-text`, hairlines in `--border`.
- Use `--color-primary-600` for primary actions, `--color-primary-500` on hover, and `--ring` for focus rings.
- Set headings in "Inter", body in "Inter", code in "IBM Plex Mono".
- Take type sizes from `--text-*`, weights from `--font-weight-*`, corner radii from `--radius-*`, spacing from `--space-*`, shadows from `--shadow-*`.
- Animate with `--duration-*` and `--ease-*`, and turn transitions off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Switch to the dark values of the semantic tokens and shadows in dark mode.

### Don't

- Invent raw hex, `rgb()` or named CSS colors.
- Use any font family other than the three above.
- Darken or lighten a color by hand for dark mode.
- Put the accent color on a large surface; it is for highlights, badges and secondary emphasis.
- Use a type size, radius, spacing, shadow or duration that is not a token.
- Use `transition: all`, or an easing that overshoots, on a state change.
